description: 200W Dual 40A Non-Isolated DC-DC Converter with PMBus
output_voltage: 0.6-5.2V DC (adjustable); 0.6-3.3V for VIN 7.5-14V, up to 5.2V only for VIN 10-14V (datasheet electrical table)
interface: PMBus Part 1 Rev 1.2 / Part 2 Rev 1.2 (PMBus_REVISION 0x98 default 0x22, datasheet PMBus_REVISION (98h) command); SMBus 2.0 compatible, with SALRT
default_i2c_address: 0x5A (unconfirmed -- this module uses pin-strapped addressing per the datasheet; PMBusTM_REVISION (0x98) reports 0x22)

PAGE.description: Page select. 0x00=page 0, 0x01=page 1, 0xFF=both controllers (datasheet PAGE (00h) command). The datasheet text maps pages to phases inconsistently ('phase1 (page 01), phase2 (page 00)'), so do not assume page N = output N+1 without checking the board.

CLEAR_FAULTS.description: Send Byte -- no data payload (previously documented as size 1).

PHASE.description: Phase select for multi-phase. Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary (pp.22-25) -- do not assume support without a device-specific source.

VOUT_MODE.description: Output voltage mode: bits 7:5 mode (000 = linear), bits 4:0 exponent (5-bit two's complement). Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary, but the ZL8802 datasheet (FN8760 Rev 3.00) lists it with default 0x13 (linear, exponent -13), and it reads back 0x13 on an LGA80D on hardware (cm_mcu issue #300: psreg 1 20 = 0x..13). Matches the fixed exponent -13 used for Linear16 VOUT values in this package. Read it as one byte (a word read adds an extraneous high byte).

VOUT_MAX.description: Maximum output voltage clamp. Previously documented at 0x25, which is actually VOUT_MARGIN_HIGH -- writing MAX at the old address changed the margin-high setpoint, not the clamp.

VOUT_MARGIN_HIGH.description: Margin high setpoint. Previously documented at 0x2A (reserved/wrong).

VOUT_MARGIN_LOW.description: Margin low setpoint. Previously documented at 0x2B (reserved/wrong).

IOUT_COMMAND.description: Target current limit. Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary.

IOUT_MAX.description: Max output current. Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary.

IOUT_OC_FAULT_LIMIT.description: Overcurrent fault threshold. Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary; the documented AVERAGE overcurrent threshold is IOUT_AVG_OC_FAULT_LIMIT (0xE7).

VIN_OV_WARN_LIMIT.description: Input overvoltage warning threshold (Linear11). Previously mislabeled VIN_UV_WARN_LIMIT at this address, which would configure the wrong protection boundary.

VIN_UV_WARN_LIMIT.description: Input undervoltage warning threshold (Linear11). Previously documented at 0x57, which is actually VIN_OV_WARN_LIMIT.

VIN_UV_FAULT_LIMIT.description: Input UV fault threshold (Linear11). Previously documented at 0x58, which is actually VIN_UV_WARN_LIMIT.

PMBUS_REVISION.description: Reports the PMBus revision used; observed value 0x22 on this device.

READ_IIN.description: Measured IIN. Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary.

READ_PIN.description: Measured input power. Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary.

READ_POUT.description: Measured POUT. Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary.

MFR_ID.description: Manufacturer ID, variable-length ASCII SMBus block, up to 32 bytes per string; the sum of all strings (MFR_ID/MFR_MODEL/MFR_REVISION/MFR_LOCATION/MFR_DATE/MFR_SERIAL/USER_DATA_00) plus one byte per command cannot exceed 128 bytes (datasheet MFR_ID command). Previously documented as fixed 12-byte RO -- it is R/W and not fixed-width. This code's block-read guard (LGA80D.read_block raising NotImplementedError) is intentional until true SMBus block transport exists; do not remove that guard to 'support' this field.

MFR_MODEL.description: No standalone MFR_MODEL command entry appears in this edition's supported-command summary (pp.22-25) -- it is only mentioned inside the shared byte-budget prose for MFR_ID/MFR_DATE/MFR_SERIAL/etc. Do not assert a fixed address/shape for it.

MFR_REVISION.description: Variable-length ASCII, same 128-byte shared budget as MFR_ID (32 bytes per string). Not previously documented.

MFR_LOCATION.description: Variable-length ASCII, same 128-byte shared budget as MFR_ID (32 bytes per string). Not previously documented.

MFR_DATE.description: Variable-length ASCII, same 128-byte shared budget as MFR_ID (32 bytes per string). Not previously documented.

MFR_SERIAL.description: Serial number, variable-length ASCII SMBus block, up to 32 bytes (same 128-byte shared budget as MFR_ID (32 bytes per string)). Previously documented as fixed 12-byte RO.

MFR_VIN_MIN.description: Min VIN (7.5V). Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary.

MFR_VIN_MAX.description: Max VIN (14V). Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary.

MFR_VOUT_MIN.description: Min VOUT (0.6V). Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary.

MFR_VOUT_MAX.description: Max VOUT (5.2V). Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary.

MFR_IOUT_MAX.description: Device is rated 80A, not 880A -- previous '880A' description was an arithmetic typo. Not listed in this edition's supported-command summary; support itself is unverified.

FREQUENCY_SWITCH.description: Switching frequency config. Previously documented as 'SW_FREQ' at 0xB0, which is actually USER_DATA_00 (variable-length ASCII).

USER_DATA_00.description: Variable-length ASCII user data, same 128-byte shared budget as MFR_ID (32 bytes per string). Previously mislabeled as a fixed switching-frequency register at this address.

USER_DATA.description: Fixed 4-byte user data. Not confirmed as a supported command in this edition -- do not assume this fixed shape without a device-specific source.

STORE_USER_ALL.description: Send Byte -- no data. This is the actual NVM store command (p.22). Previously, this file's 'NVM_WRITE' entry pointed to 0xD0 (ISENSE_CONFIG, a 2-byte current-sense configuration command) with payload 0x5A -- using that recipe would reconfigure current-sense settings, which can affect protection, instead of storing anything.

ISENSE_CONFIG.description: Current-sense configuration. Previously mislabeled 'NVM_WRITE' in this file -- do not use this to attempt an NVM store.

ASCR_CONFIG.description: ASCR configuration (4 bytes: bit field and unsigned binary gain/residual, datasheet ASCR_CONFIG (DFh) command). Previously mislabeled 'RESET' with payload 0xA5 in this file -- there is no documented reset payload for this command, and writing to it can reconfigure the control loop. No software-reset command is confirmed for this device in this edition; do not assume one exists.

SNAPSHOT.description: Atomic monitoring snapshot; requires SNAPSHOT_CONTROL=0x01 capture first, then ~40ms before the block read returns valid data (confirmed against MCU firmware LocalTasks.c:snapdump_locked -- ~20ms was found insufficient; the datasheet gives no copy time). Reading this block needs a real SMBus block read, which LGA80D.read_block() intentionally does not implement and which the MCU's generic DC path cannot do (4-byte transfer limit). It is read through the MCU ProgCom 'SN' device instead: LGA80D.read_snapshot(page) sends 'w SN <dev> <page> 00 01' (the MCU captures and caches the 32 bytes), then eight 'r SN <dev> <page> <off> 4' reads of the cache, and decodes snapshot_t (commands/PowerCommands.c): v_in L11, v_out L16u, i_out L11 (signed), i_out_max L11, duty L11, temperature L11, 2 unused bytes, frequency L11 at bytes 14-15, then 7 status bytes (VOUT, IOUT, INPUT, TEMPERATURE, CML, MFR, flash) at bytes 16-22 and 9 unused. Needs firmware with the SN device (not in older images).

SNAPSHOT_CONTROL.description: Datasheet SNAPSHOT_CONTROL (F3h): 0x01 copies the NVRAM snapshot into the readable SNAPSHOT parameter, 0x02 writes the current snapshot to NVRAM and 0x03 erases the NVRAM snapshot (0x02 and 0x03 only while the device is disabled; all other values ignored). MCU firmware uses 0x01 to capture, then 0x03 to reset the snapshot history -- confirmed (MCU firmware comment, LocalTasks.c:snapdump_locked) that this reset write 'will fail if the device is on': the output for that page must be off first. See device/lga80d.py LGA80D.reset_snapshot()/reset_all_snapshots() and registry.py Registry.reset_all_lga80d_snapshots(), which checks the MCU power state machine is POWER_OFF before issuing this, since the firmware itself does not enforce that precondition.

RESTORE_USER_ALL.description: Send Byte -- no data. Restores all PMBus settings from the USER store to operating memory.

VOUT_CAL_OFFSET.description: Fixed offset applied to the VOUT command (Linear16 signed, exponent -13).

VOUT_DROOP.description: Load-line V/I slope for the rail, mV/A (Linear11).

INTERLEAVE.description: Phase offset when sharing a common SYNC clock (Linear11 format, global). Default set by the pin-strapped PMBus address.

VOUT_OV_FAULT_RESPONSE.description: VOUT overvoltage fault response (bit field; retry time in 35 ms units). Default 0x80.

VOUT_UV_FAULT_RESPONSE.description: VOUT undervoltage fault response (bit field; retry time in 35 ms units). Default 0x80.

OT_FAULT_LIMIT.description: Over-temperature fault limit, degC (Linear11). Default 0xEBE8 (+125 C).

OT_FAULT_RESPONSE.description: Over-temperature fault response (bit field; retry time in 35 ms units). Default 0xFF.

OT_WARN_LIMIT.description: Over-temperature warning limit, degC (Linear11). Default 0xEB70 (+110 C).

VIN_OV_FAULT_LIMIT.description: VIN overvoltage fault threshold, V (Linear11, global). Default 0xD3E0 (15.5 V).

VIN_OV_FAULT_RESPONSE.description: VIN overvoltage fault response (bit field, global). Default 0x80.

VIN_UV_FAULT_RESPONSE.description: VIN undervoltage fault response (bit field, global; retry time in 35 ms units). Default 0xBF.

POWER_GOOD_ON.description: Power-good assert threshold, V (Linear16 unsigned). Default 0.9 x VSET pin-strap.

DDC_CONFIG.description: DDC addressing and current sharing (bit field). Default set by pin-strapped PMBus address and CFG pin-strap.

POWER_GOOD_DELAY.description: Delay between PG threshold and PG assertion, ms (Linear11). Default 0xBA00.

MULTI_PHASE_RAMP_GAIN.description: Ramp-up/ramp-down rate via feedback gain (custom format). Default 0x03.

SNAPSHOT_FAULT_MASK.description: Masks faults that cause a snapshot store (bit field, global). Summary table lists 1 byte; the detail section says 2. Default 0.

MFR_SMBALERT_MASK.description: Faults that do not assert SALRT (bit field, global). Summary table lists 1 byte; the detail section says 7. Longer than the 4-byte ASCII read limit.

PINSTRAP_READ_STATUS.description: Seven 8-bit values with the pin-strap settings (global). Longer than the 4-byte ASCII read limit.

SEQUENCE.description: DDC rail sequencing configuration (bit field, paged). Default 0 (prequel and sequel disabled). Not listed with a byte count in the summary table; 2 bytes per the detail section's 16-bit field.

DDC_GROUP.description: Group ID, fault spreading, OPERATION and VOUT sharing across the DDC bus (bit field, paged). Default set by CFG pin-strap.

MFR_IOUT_OC_FAULT_RESPONSE.description: IOUT overcurrent fault response (bit field). Default 0x80.

MFR_IOUT_UC_FAULT_RESPONSE.description: IOUT undercurrent fault response (bit field). Default 0x80.

USER_GLOBAL_CONFIG.description: Output voltage sensing, VMON/TMON pin, SMBus time-out and other advanced options (bit field, global). Default set by CFG pin-strap.

LEGACY_FAULT_GROUP.description: Fault-group compatibility with older Intersil digital power devices (bit field, block R/W). Default 0x00000000.

RESTORE_FACTORY.description: Send Byte -- no data. Restores hard-coded factory defaults and pin-strap definitions (global). HAZARDOUS: discards the device configuration.

MFR_VMON_OV_FAULT_LIMIT.description: VMON overvoltage fault threshold (Linear11, global). Default 0xC266 (2.4 V, SPS OT trip voltage).

MFR_VMON_UV_FAULT_LIMIT.description: VMON undervoltage fault threshold (Linear11, global). Default 0x9B33 (0.1 V, about -50 C).

MFR_READ_VMON.description: Voltage on the VMON pin, V (Linear11, global).

VMON_OV_FAULT_RESPONSE.description: VMON overvoltage fault response (bit field). Default 0xBF.

VMON_UV_FAULT_RESPONSE.description: VMON undervoltage fault response (bit field). Default 0xBF.

SECURITY_LEVEL.description: Reports the security level (hex). Default 0x01 (public). Size from the summary table only.

PRIVATE_PASSWORD.description: Private password string (ASCII block, 9 bytes, global). Do not read or write casually.

PUBLIC_PASSWORD.description: Public password string (ASCII block, 4 bytes, global). Do not read or write casually.

monitoring_features: Output current (READ_IOUT; the datasheet text calls it 'input current', a typo -- the units/format fit output current)
notes: Linear data format used for most measurements
This module uses pin-strapped addressing, not a fixed default; do not assume 0x5A without confirming the strap configuration
Dual output (2-phase) models can be configured as two independent outputs or as a single 2-phase output (PAGE 0xFF addresses both controllers)

Entries marked '(unconfirmed)' do not appear in this datasheet edition's supported-command summary (pp.22-25) -- treat them as unverified capability claims, not proven-absent or proven-present, until checked against the exact firmware/controller revision in use

LGA80DStatus.has_faults (Python API) excludes STATUS_WORD bits 6 (OFF) and 11 (POWER_GOOD#) from the fault summary, since both are asserted for normal/intentional states, not faults -- see device/lga80d.py
